regressions.pins: Policy-rate rows map onto NormalizedRecord with TRUE effective/availability semantics: effective_time_utc is midnight of the CBPOL/EXR observation date; available_time_utc is only the owner-evidence end-of-UTC-day upper bound; the two fields are distinct (a 2024-05-01-effective rate is not eligible until 2024-05-01T23:59:59Z); availability is never invented (parse without ReleaseEvidence fails closed MISSING_AVAILABLE_TIME_EVIDENCE; ECB header.prepared is never availability); raw_sha256 ties to the fixture bytes (sha256 of bis_cbpol.json computed in-test).

PIT no-lookahead: a decision/query at time T via pit.select_asof / pit.asof_join can never return a row whose available_time_utc > T (nor, by default, one whose effective_time_utc > T); hand-pinned: on the rate's effective day (2024-05-01T00:00Z and T12:00Z) the selection still reads the OLD 4.0 rate and only after the 2024-05-01T23:59:59Z availability stamp reads 4.25; the availability gate holds even with require_effective=False.
